source.note: A curated colour is an EDITORIAL association, not a measurement, and is recorded as such: `confidence: editorial` on every token this file produces. The hue is the one Indian election graphics and the parties' own flags and symbols have long used — saffron for the BJP, sky blue for the Congress, red for the communist parties, green for the Trinamool and the Dravidian parties. No party publishes a hex value, so none is quoted as though it had. Lightness and chroma are NOT the association: they are chosen inside a measured band so the colour is legible on this product's surfaces, and so that parties sharing a hue family separate on the axis a dichromat keeps.

band.note: The range curated lightnesses sit in. It documents intent; the FLOORS are what is enforced, by viz/party-ink.test.ts: every fill clears 3:1 against all three surfaces, and one of the two inks clears 4.5:1 on top of it. Around the crossover where neither ink clears, no lightness is legal at all — which is why two of these values are not round numbers.

derived.note: Three lightnesses, each legal for EVERY hue: 0.54-0.58 is a dead band where the light ink has stopped clearing 4.5:1 and the dark ink has not started, so no generated colour may land there.
